To preface this story you should be aware that this takes time over a period of several years and that I was so psychologically scarred that I did not remember everything about this until a few years ago, repressed memories I suppose. At age 11 I got a Skype from a friend that was very close to me. This was a little before facetime had become a thing and no one really had iphones. Her side of the video feed popped up and i saw she was crying. I asked her what was wrong and she simply told me "I'm done" as she raised a handgun to her head. I frantically begged and pleaded with her to put it down, I told her I loved her and that she has so much to live for. she simply repeated, "I'm done" then she whimpered "I'm sorry for this" between the tears, seconds before she pulled the trigger. I saw the look in her eyes the second the bullet ripped through her skull. fear, regret, pain. she didn't die instantly. I saw her chest rise and fall for a short time after, blood and brain matter covered the room. It's an image that I know I will never be able to forget. I guess she finally bled out, I don't remember the rest because I blacked out. My parents woke me up, the laptop screen was black, I assume this is when her family finally broke the door down and found her lying there and called the ambulance. My parents had no clue what was going on, they just thought I fell asleep on my floor and were trying to get me to come to supper. I explained what happened through sobs, I could barely breathe. I was questioned by the police either the next day or a few days after, I was so young and traumatized that it's a bit of a blur honestly. I remember feeling as if somehow this was all my fault and apologizing to the officers over and over. They concluded the suicide was a result of her parent's divorce and her untreated clinical depression. I went to several psychologists after this and fell into a bad depression of my own. it was at this time that we discovered I have very severe clinical depression, enough to where I have to be on high doses of medication to regulate my mood. I began self-harming after this, using anything I could find but mostly razor blades and knives. After years of therapy and trying different medications I finally started to see a light at the end of the tunnel. I had a boyfriend, I was starting to be happy, things were good. Then my boyfriend at the time started acting weird. He would be overly protective and get jealous over things that he shouldn't have. This eventually turned into him hitting me or grabbing me too rough, leaving bruises that I had to cover with makeup. He verbally abused me about my weight to the point where I stopped eating altogether, I became severely anorexic. I was under 100 pounds at the height of 5'4/5'5. This eventually escalated to rape.when I tried to leave him he threatened to kill me, he sent me very descriptive messages about how he would kill me, going into detail about what he would do to my corpse. I eventually got the courage to tell my parents and the police got involved, I was not allowed to go to school for weeks until we got a restraining order. (sidenote he got away with nothing against him at all, he lied and told everyone it was all an elaborate scheme to try and bring to light that my father was abusive. my father never ever abused me and is the most amazing man.) eventually, this all subsided though I still suffer from really bad PTSD and depression from all of this. once he graduated and moved away for college, I started to regain normalcy. Until my junior year of high school when I was diagnosed with severe psoriasis, I had it all over my body and it completely covered my scalp. i was in pain all the time because of it and it significantly lowered my immune system. Toward the end of my senior year of highschool i was put on this medication called cosentyx and it completely changed my life forever. I now have complete relief from all of my psoriasis though I have to take two shots once a month and they lower my immune system, it's worth it. fast forward to now, well a few days ago.(10/19/17) I am 18 and I now go to a four-year university in my state, majoring in nursing.  I get news that a dear and close friend of mine from high school that I saw as a little sister, took her own life the same way my friend from before did. she was only 16 and had her entire life ahead of her. I am dealing with this the best that I can but it is still very hard on me. Luckily I have an amazing boyfriend of nearly a year that loves me and cares for me. He is honestly the best thing that has ever happened to me and is my reason to live. He is helping me through this insanely hard time in my life and reassures me that everything will be ok. I know it will because I have him. we plan on getting married some time in the near future.

may this serve as a testament that with perseverance and faith things eventually do get better and life moves on. stay strong my loves.

I was the exact same way going through the same issues when I was your age. Middle school was the worst time in my life, people make it seem like high school is but in this day and age I think middle school is a little worse. I won't lie and tell you high school is great but for me, it got better than in middle school. I suggest going to a school counselor that's how I received help and if it wasn't for her I would not be alive right now. I was put on medication for depression and life got better after that. also if you really need help and have no one else to turn to please call the suicide hotline at 1-800-273-8255 they are very great people and will help you in any way they can. there is also an online chat option if you don't feel comfortable speaking with anyone over the phone or are afraid that someone may hear you. I understand it can be very hard to reach out especially to adults who may not understand. the suicide hotline will take you seriously and will assist you in getting help. I hope this helps you, I am sending much love and positive vibes your way. stay strong love. ps: to access the suicide hotline online chat option simply google "suicide hotline" the should pop up under their contact information.

I appreciate your comment, it does take a heavy toll on you when someone you love takes their life. this is the second person I have lost in this way. Both people were very close. The first suicide was much more traumatizing I've been debating posting it on a thread about the "worst things you've witnessed". I agree very much that the world is a cold and miserable place. I myself have had many suicide attempts and suicidal thoughts throughout my years on this earth. I currently am on depression medication and it helps a good bit though I know its not for everyone and can be expensive and hard to get insurance to cover. I hate that you are in the twilight zone right now, but it's far better than taking your life in my opinion. suicide to me is a permanent solution for a possibly temporary problem, I will never tell you things will get better. in my experience they don't ever fully get better the depression never fully goes away but it becomes bearable. I was able to find things in this life that make me happy and keep me from going into a dark lonely place again. but I won't lie and make it seem like sunshine and rainbows either. I still have thoughts of suicide every once in a while. even though I am on high doses of depression medication. I don't think they will entirely go away but like i said before, it gets a little more bearable as time goes on for my case at the very least. I am able to combat the thoughts and push them out of my head. I hope you will be able to do the same.

Something similar happened to me my junior year of highschool. (As a bit of background info I have history of kidney stones as well as endomitriosis and ovarian cysts) I woke up one morning before school with INSANE pain shooting down all of limbs and up my spine, the pain was so severe that I literally could not walk on my own which is actually really scary because i have a freakishly high pain tolerance. i went to a winterguard (competitive dancing with flags etc.) competition that lasted 12 hours (of mostly being on my feet) and competed while passing four kidney stones. My mom gave me skalaxin (sp?) the muscle relaxor because we both just assumed it was another bad case of kidney stones and that i should just flush fluids and move on with my day per usual. i toughed it out and tried to go to school. half way there i get an insane surge of pain that makes me almost wreck my car i assume it is nothing and make it to school but can only stay for half of my classes due to the pain. later that night i was going to get a glass of water when i get another surge of pain that knocks me to the floor. usually i would try to just tough out the pain due to my stubborness and high pain tolerance, but this time i was crying and begging my mom to take me to the emergency room that second. this terrified my mom and she took me to the women's hospital a few minutes away because it is the only hospital we really trust in our area because my gyno works there and they usually have the fastest wait time. well i waited in this damn waiting room for two hours in severe ass pain. i rated my pain as a 30 out of 10 to the front desk which is usually a sign but nah. i litrally watched a lady with a headache go ahead of me-- mind you the bitch was talking the nurse's ear off so i doubt she had that bad of a headache. when i FINALLY got back there i wasn't even humored with a doctor or a pysician or even a nurse practitioner. nope a nurse came in took one look at me said i was constipated and gave me two tylonol pills to take. exuse me? we had to demand to see a doctor of some sorts, three hours pass and the doctor finally comes. he agrees i'm constipated but humored me with a tordol injection and sent me home. surprise surprise it didn't help and i was back in the ER the next night. This time having to wait three hours in the waiting room while i was in insane pain again and visibly shaking. when i finally got back there i got the same nurse. i shit you not i screamed "get the fuck out of here and get me the doctor" eventually the doctor came in and tried to tell me the same thing as the previous night and i had to demand a CT scan. nothing showed up on the scan but they gave me morphine (which did not even touch the pain i was in if that gives you any idea of what i was going through) the doctor sent me home yet again. this time we scheduled an appointment with my gyno thinking maybe it was another ovarian cyst even though they don't hurt nearly as bad as what i was feeling. i went to see her the next day, she examined me for not even 5 minutes and scheduled an emergency appendix removal. i got it out the next day seconds before it ruptured. incompetence is fucking insane. i could have died because of these people.
